caption:
Social Security checks are getting a 3.6% raise in 2027. 📬

That's about $75 more per month for the average person, starting in January.

But Medicare Part B premiums usually come out of that check first, so the take-home bump can look smaller.

Do you think a 3.6% raise actually matches what things cost you?
